_readme: Y-12: the one file behind events.html (and, later, the profile page's badge list). Dates are NOT stored here: they come from shared/seasonal-events.js (DEFAULT_EVENTS) and shared/seasonal-dates.json, so the page, the games and the tests agree. This file holds the copy, the proposed host game and the badge colour for each event id. Host mapping and tasks are PROPOSALS from planning/SEASONAL-EVENTS.md that the owner has not confirmed; a host's status is 'coming' until its game actually calls NoyvjSeasonal.init, then change it to 'live'. Badge ids are NoyvjSeasonal.badgeId: <event id with hyphens>-<year>, e.g. halloween-2026.

events.name: New Year
events.about: The turn of the year, 1 January.
events.task: Fund the Near Bodies research tier during the window
